title.hi: वह संघर्ष जिसे कोई जीत न सका
title.en: The Battle No One Could Win

logline: The herd tries and fails to free Gajendra from the crocodile; the extraordinary struggle and his eventual spiritual decision follow in later scenes.

source.edition: Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam Canto 8 Chapter 2; original trilingual paraphrase, not copied English translation
source.verification_notes: Scene S01 preserves the actual failed pull from behind in SB 8.2.28, distinct from the helpers' mere approach ending S01E01. Eight original spoken paraphrases and one separately disclosed original ripple insert. SB 8.2.29's thousand-year struggle is reserved for later S01E02 scenes. The chosen left foreleg and bank orientation are screen geography, not verse details. Verified against 8.2.27–29 on 2026-11-22. S02 uses SB 8.2.27 for Gajendra's continued effort and SB 8.2.29 for opposing land/water pulling. L002 and L008 are disclosed original shore-footing/trunk blocking; do not imply a 1000-year duration before S04. S03: SB 8.2.30 establishes the crocodile's water habitat. This short scene introduces only that fact; no years or physical power shift is narrated until the canonical S04/S05 progression. S04: The thousand-year duration and startled devas are both explicitly stated in SB 8.2.29. Time montage is cinematic original, not invented historical events. S05: Only after the thousand-year scene, Gajendra loses physical, mental and sensory strength while the water-dwelling crocodile becomes stronger (SB 8.2.30). The first recognition and reflection of 8.2.31 leads to S06. S06: Gajendra's realization and decision (8.2.31–32) and confidence in the Supreme Lord as ultimate shelter (8.2.33) finish the episode; the exact prayer is reserved for S01E03. One disclosed original transitional line closes.

core_preserved: Other elephants grasp Gajendra from behind but cannot rescue him from the strong crocodile (SB 8.2.28).
Female elephants cry out in distress (SB 8.2.28).
The unsuccessful rescue leaves Gajendra still trapped before the long struggle (8.2.28–29).
Gajendra exerts strength to escape his caught foot (8.2.27), and the elephant and crocodile pull against one another toward and away from the water (8.2.29).
SB 8.2.30 establishes the crocodile's water habitat. This short scene introduces only that fact; no years or physical power shift is narrated until the canonical S04/S05 progression.
The thousand-year duration and startled devas are both explicitly stated in SB 8.2.29. Time montage is cinematic original, not invented historical events.

Only after the thousand-year scene, Gajendra loses physical, mental and sensory strength while the water-dwelling crocodile becomes stronger (SB 8.2.30). The first recognition and reflection of 8.2.31 leads to S06.

Gajendra's realization and decision (8.2.31–32) and confidence in the Supreme Lord as ultimate shelter (8.2.33) finish the episode; the exact prayer is reserved for S01E03. One disclosed original transitional line closes.
changes: Continue directly from E01/S06; no second new attack.
Exact left foreleg, shore orientation and helper staging are original 16:9 continuity decisions.
L003 surface ripples are original staging, not another scripture event.
No named herd character or human-spoken elephant/crocodile lines; no gore or fabricated rescue.
Future S02–S06 contain the ongoing contest, thousand years, changing advantage and turn to divine refuge; none are authored yet.
In S02, the exact near-bank foothold and raised-trunk gesture are original cinema staging; the thousand-year duration is reserved for S04.
S03 original shot pacing/light blocking is declared cinematic staging; all named scripture events remain verse-attributed.
S04 original shot pacing/light blocking is declared cinematic staging; all named scripture events remain verse-attributed.
adaptation.fidelity_note: Independent simple child-friendly Telugu/Hindi/English paraphrase of SB 8.2.28. The physical failed pull from behind and female elephants' cries are source events; all water staging is clearly differentiated and unrecorded.

characters.description: Only offscreen spoken owner in the nine-line trilingual scene.
characters.voice_direction: Warm serious plain Telugu/Hindi/English, future human timing needed; no selected actor or TTS.

characters.description: User-approved decorated grey Indian elephant visual identity, naturally quadrupedal and unable to free his left foreleg.
characters.voice_direction: No human-spoken mouth line, only future nonverbal elephant SFX.

characters.description: User-approved stylized slightly fierce olive crocodile retaining one jaw and tail, consistent scale and hold.
characters.voice_direction: No human-spoken words or lip sync, future natural water/animal SFX only.

scenes.title: The herd rushes to help
scenes.setting: Immediate continuation of S01E01/S06 at the same Ṛtumat freshwater lotus lake: established near bank to the editorial left, deeper lake to the right; crocodile still holding Gajendra's chosen left foreleg, which is a continuity choice not specified in scripture.
scenes.action: Adult elephants now actually take hold of Gajendra from behind and pull to free him. The crocodile remains firmly attached; female elephants cry, other elephants cannot rescue him. This fulfills SB 8.2.28, not merely the approach shown in E01/S06. No long-time montage, new attack, injury, magic or escape.
nonverbal_beats: Start precisely where E01/S06 stops; show the same approved decorated grey Gajendra and stylized fierce olive crocodile at the same scale, with natural quadruped anatomy.
Adult herd elephants approach the rear of Gajendra. Calves remain behind larger adults; this is original staging, not new narrated scripture.
Clearly stage adult elephants grasping from behind and trying to draw Gajendra free, as SB 8.2.28 says; the attempt fails.
Retain the crocodile grip on the chosen left foreleg and unchanged shore/deeper-water geography; no blood, wound, horror effect, additional jaws or tails.
Gentle normal water ripples in L003 are separately disclosed original cinematography. Animal calls are nonverbal PLANNED SFX, not generated recordings or spoken dialogue.
End after the unsuccessful rescue, with grip unresolved. The thousand-year struggle of SB 8.2.29 belongs to subsequent scenes.

shots.action: Establish the same bank-facing trapped Gajendra/crocodile and adult elephants now gathering behind him; narration L001–L003. Only normal ripples as a disclosed original visual insert.
shots.camera: 16:9 medium-wide full-body master, near bank left and deeper water right; do not give every herd elephant Gajendra's unique headpiece.
shots.sound: NARRATOR owns spoken lines; gentle splashes and elephant movement PLANNED, not present.

shots.action: Other elephants take hold from behind and visibly pull together. Their combined effort fails against the crocodile's hold; narration L004–L006. Show the source's actual rescue attempt.
shots.camera: 16:9 stable side/three-quarter full-body composition with left foreleg contact and helper elephants physically behind Gajendra; no axis reversal or injury closeup.
shots.sound: NARRATOR with future restrained water effort and elephant calls as unproduced SFX.

shots.action: Female elephants cry; all recognize that even together they cannot free their leader. End on Gajendra still restrained; narration L007–L009. No passage of many years yet.
shots.camera: Return to 16:9 bank-facing wide shot with calves behind adults; keep natural elephant and crocodile silhouette and scale.
shots.sound: Gentle animal calls and environmental tail PLANNED. No human mouth-synced dialogue or finished sound.

scenes.title: Gajendra strains toward land
scenes.setting: Same near-shallow shore at Ṛtumat lake after failed herd rescue in S01; Gajendra's selected left foreleg remains caught by same olive crocodile. His own effort now becomes the focus.
scenes.action: Gajendra repeatedly attempts to reach firm ground while the crocodile resists and pulls back toward water, as SB 8.2.27 and the in/out-water contest of 8.2.29 establish. Do not yet claim one thousand years pass; S04 owns that narration.
nonverbal_beats: Start precisely after the failed herd pull of S01, with no new arrival or grip event.
The landward-footing detail and raised trunk are original visual staging, not separate scripture incidents.
Use only the owner's full-body approved Gajendra and slightly fierce storybook crocodile design; no realistic horror, no skin injury or human mouth motion.
Alternate the physically understandable shoreward and waterward force without changing which left foreleg is gripped, the position of the near bank, or the identity scale.
Hold the unfinished contest before explaining the crocodile's aquatic advantage in S03 or the thousand years in S04.

shots.action: Gajendra, after his herd could not rescue him, braces toward the near bank, struggling against the same left-foreleg crocodile grip; narration L001–L003. Bank-footing detail is original staging.
shots.camera: 16:9 side medium-wide, show full natural quadruped, bank left, deeper water right, keep exact approved costume.
shots.sound: NARRATOR only; subdued water and effort sounds remain PLANNED SFX.

shots.action: Two opposing pulls at the waterline as Gajendra tries toward shore and crocodile back toward lake; narration L004–L006. No second surprise bite or successful separation.
shots.camera: 16:9 static three-quarter at existing waterline; visible single left-leg attachment and one crocodile tail; avoid rapid camera cuts.
shots.sound: NARRATOR only with future natural water displacement; no invented animal words.

shots.action: Crocodile draws Gajendra slightly back toward deeper water; elephant braces and lifts trunk; grip unchanged; narration L007–L009. Trunk gesture is disclosed original blocking.
shots.camera: 16:9 stable full-body wide side; maintain existing left-bank/deeper-right geography and scale.
shots.sound: NARRATOR only, gentle water movement and brief unmeasured hold.

scenes.title: The crocodile holds in the water
scenes.setting: Same Ṛtumat freshwater lotus lake: the approved olive crocodile in its natural water habitat retains Gajendra's editorial left foreleg, near bank left and deeper water right. Only physical contest now, not the thousand-year passage.
scenes.action: The crocodile remains active in the lake while Gajendra, a land animal, finds resistance difficult. Water is the crocodile's home (8.2.30); keep the long-term weakening/strengthening outcome for S05, after S04's explicit thousand-year montage.
nonverbal_beats: Continue seamlessly from S02's shoreward back-and-forth pull; do not replay a new leg grab or group rescue.
Show water as the crocodile's natural habitat without prematurely asserting it has gained strength over centuries.
Gajendra remains naturally quadrupedal with user-approved red-gold blanket and headpiece; keep the same held left foreleg, riverbank and lotus geometry.
No graphic injury or human animal voices; any balancing movement is original staging, not verse footage.
End poised for the next scene's explicitly time-compressed thousand-year struggle.

shots.action: Water-level full-body profile of olive crocodile secure in lake, contrasting with Gajendra trying to stand; narration L001–L003.
shots.camera: Stable 16:9 medium-wide, both animal silhouettes and chosen leg contact, bank left, deeper water right.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

shots.action: Gajendra struggles for footing, crocodile still grips, pulls remain near the same waterline; narration L004–L006.
shots.camera: Steady 16:9 natural side view, no leg swap or animal mouth animation.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

shots.action: Continue waterline tension and hold for passage of time next scene; narration L007–L008.
shots.camera: Clean 16:9 distant full-body wide, conserve geographic continuity; no time-lapse yet.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

scenes.title: Many years pass
scenes.setting: Same Trikūṭa garden freshwater lake as S01–S03, with a nonliteral long-time visual montage at the same shore/water geometry; no new location, age redesign or separate attack.
scenes.action: The narrator explicitly states the contest between the elephant and crocodile lasts a thousand years (SB 8.2.29), with brief seasonal time-montage cues as original illustration. Devas observe in wonder without invented speech.
nonverbal_beats: Begin with continuing struggle; seasonal light and passing years may be indicated through original editing transitions, not a single literal real-time endurance shot.
Say one thousand years explicitly and unambiguously as scripture, not a metaphorical ordinary-day fight.
Show the in/out-water back-and-forth from verse 29. Keep the same consistent approved elephant/crocodile identity and held leg across time.
Show distant, unnamed, respectful silhouettes of astonished devas only when future references have been approved. No new named deity or dialogue.
The long-term weakening of Gajendra and the crocodile's growing strength are narrated in the next scene S05 from SB 8.2.30, not prematurely altered by this montage.

shots.action: First time-compression: same gripping pair, days and seasons suggested by ambient light/foliage changes; narration L001–L003.
shots.camera: 16:9 fixed lake master with subtle symbolic seasonal dissolves; stable bank left and deeper water right.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

shots.action: Explicit thousand-year passage over the prolonged contest, back-and-forth in and out of water; narration L004–L006.
shots.camera: 16:9 wide montage preserving one leg-grip topology and full-body approved anatomy, no newly invented combat injuries.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

shots.action: Enduring contest beneath distant observers; devas' astonishment noted without new named performers; narration L007–L009.
shots.camera: 16:9 shore-facing wide with future celestial silhouettes only once separately designed/approved; no change to Gajendra and crocodile identity.
shots.sound: PLANNED natural water/animal/ambience only, offscreen NARRATOR sole spoken owner; no media generated.

scenes.title: Strength ebbs and concern grows
scenes.setting: The same lotus lake after SB 8.2.29's explicit one-thousand-year struggle: the elephant remains caught on the editorial left foreleg and the crocodile remains in its own lake, with no new attack or altered creature identity.
scenes.action: Describe the exact long-term asymmetry in SB 8.2.30: Gajendra loses mental/physical strength in water while the aquatic crocodile gains strength. Lead carefully into his recognition of mortal danger (8.2.31), not to a fabricated divine punishment.
nonverbal_beats: Allow the posture of Gajendra to look tired after the thousand years, without changing his essential approved face, tusks, four-leg anatomy or decorative identity.
The crocodile's aquatic confidence increases in the scripture, but do not invent extra predators, new teeth, gore, or magical form changes.
Show same left-foreleg grip, shoreline direction and water level throughout; maintain safe family-oriented storytelling.
Gajendra's fatigue includes mental energy, not grotesque emaciation. Natural subdued sound and slower camera beats are future SFX/film design.
End in reflective worry, and save the decision to seek the Supreme Lord for S06.

shots.action: After long montage Gajendra's posture and effort noticeably tire; narration L001–L003.
shots.camera: 16:9 full-body three-quarter of approved Gajendra, consistent tusks, trunk and jewelry; no severe injury.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

shots.action: Crocodile remains efficient in its home water as the balance shifts; narration L004–L006.
shots.camera: 16:9 clear lake depth and held left foreleg, same crocodile scales/jaw/tail, no horror closeup.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

shots.action: Gajendra recognizes danger and begins sustained thought, without speaking like a human; narration L007–L009.
shots.camera: 16:9 stable dignified face/trunk reaction then wide lake hold; no animal lip-sync.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

scenes.title: A decision to seek refuge
scenes.setting: Gajendra remains caught beside the unchanged freshwater lotus lake after the long trial; his physical body is still the locked approved Indian elephant, while the decision to seek divine refuge is conveyed solely through narrator and quiet visual reaction.
scenes.action: Gajendra understands that even the herd cannot free him, reflects deeply and resolves to seek shelter in the Supreme Lord (8.2.31–32), recalling the Lord's power to protect those who surrender (8.2.33). End at the threshold of his extended prayer, which begins in Episode 3.
nonverbal_beats: Do not reinterpret his affection for the herd as a sin or the crocodile attack as punishment; his loved ones tried honestly but could not save him.
Portray the turn inward through calm pauses, natural elephant eye/trunk gestures and a respectful offscreen narrator, never a talking humanoid elephant.
Source 8.2.31–33 reflects thoughtful realization and divine shelter. Do not introduce the full prayer or a magical on-screen mantra here; Episode 3 covers the remembered prayer of 8.3.
Keep crocodile grip and geography stable; do not show Narayana or Garuda rescuing him early.
A single closing quiet view of the lotus lake bridges to Episode 3 prayer without inventing a new scripture event.

shots.action: Gajendra's sustained thought and remembrance of the unsuccessful herd rescue; narration L001–L003.
shots.camera: 16:9 steady full-body Gajendra in lake, slight face/trunk change without lip-sync, helpers in established distance.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

shots.action: Reflection on loved ones and his decision to seek the Supreme Lord's shelter; narration L004–L006.
shots.camera: 16:9 restrained side medium-wide, stable held left foreleg and same waterline, no rescue vision.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

shots.action: A reverent refuge thought ends in the moment just before formal prayer begins; narration L007–L009.
shots.camera: 16:9 calm lotus/elephant framing with soft original environmental tail, no divine avatar or new named animal.
shots.sound: Future ambient lake and animal SFX only; NARRATOR is the only spoken owner; no recording/voice is present.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Introduce adults reaching Gajendra

text.te: మొసలి పట్టులో ఉన్న గజేంద్రుడి దగ్గరకు మిగతా ఏనుగులు చేరుకున్నాయి.
text.hi: मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में फँसे गजेन्द्र के पास बाकी हाथी आ गए।
text.en: The other elephants reached Gajendra, still caught by the crocodile.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Position the herd for the source's rear-body rescue

text.te: తమ నాయకుడికి సాయం చేయడానికి అవి అతని వెనుక వైపు చేరాయి.
text.hi: अपने नेता की मदद के लिए वे उसके पीछे इकट्ठा हुए।
text.en: They gathered behind their leader, ready to help.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Disclose original surface-wave staging

text.te: అవి కదులుతుండగా సరస్సు నీళ్లలో చిన్న అలలు వచ్చాయి.
text.hi: उनके हिलने से झील के पानी में छोटी-छोटी लहरें उठीं।
text.en: Small waves spread as the elephants moved through the shallows.

source_attribution.note: Original gentle water-ripple movement around elephants entering the established shallows. SB 8.2.28 recounts their failed help, not a separate rippling-water incident.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Depict the rear-body grasp stated in 8.2.28

text.te: అవి గజేంద్రుడిని వెనుక నుంచి పట్టుకున్నాయి.
text.hi: उन्होंने गजेन्द्र को पीछे से पकड़ लिया।
text.en: They took hold of Gajendra from behind.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Depict the collective rescue attempt

text.te: అన్నీ కలిసి తమ బలమంతా పెట్టి లాగాయి.
text.hi: सबने मिलकर पूरी ताकत से खींचा।
text.en: Together, they pulled with all their strength.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate failure of the rescue

text.te: కానీ మొసలి పట్టు చాలా బలంగా ఉండడంతో గజేంద్రుడి కాలు విడిపోలేదు.
text.hi: लेकिन मगरमच्छ की पकड़ इतनी मज़बूत थी कि गजेन्द्र का पैर नहीं छूटा।
text.en: But the crocodile's grip was too strong to break.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Describe sorrow without invented speech

text.te: ఆడ ఏనుగులు బాధతో గట్టిగా ఘీంకరించాయి.
text.hi: हथिनियाँ दुःख से पुकारने लगीं।
text.en: The female elephants cried out in distress.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Restate the source's unsuccessful rescue

text.te: గుంపంతా తమ నాయకుడిని రక్షించడానికి ప్రయత్నించింది. అయినా సాధ్యపడలేదు.
text.hi: झुंड ने अपने नेता को बचाने की कोशिश की, मगर वे सफल नहीं हुए।
text.en: The herd had tried to rescue its leader. It could not.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Conclude scene with grip unchanged

text.te: ఎంత ప్రయత్నించినా గజేంద్రుడు మొసలి పట్టులోనే చిక్కుకుని ఉన్నాడు.
text.hi: इतनी कोशिशों के बाद भी गजेन्द्र मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में फँसे रहे।
text.en: Gajendra remained caught, even after all their efforts.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra kept trying to free his trapped leg.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు తన కాలును విడిపించుకోవడానికి మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र अपना फँसा हुआ पैर छुड़ाने की कोशिश करता रहा।
text.en: Gajendra kept trying to free his trapped leg.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.delivery: Physical shoreline blocking, calm and clear
dialogue.intent: He tried to plant his feet in the shallows near the bank.

text.te: ఒడ్డుకు దగ్గరలోని లోతు తక్కువ నీళ్లలో నిలబడేందుకు ప్రయత్నించాడు.
text.hi: उसने किनारे के पास उथले पानी में पैर जमाने की कोशिश की।
text.en: He tried to plant his feet in the shallows near the bank.

source_attribution.note: Original clear physical blocking at the shallow bank: Gajendra planting his feet is a cinematic interpretation, not a separate incident in SB 8.2.27–29.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: With great effort, he pulled toward solid ground.

text.te: ఎంతో కష్టపడి ఒడ్డువైపు లాగాడు.
text.hi: बहुत ज़ोर लगाकर वह किनारे की ओर खिंचा।
text.en: With great effort, he pulled toward solid ground.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The crocodile pulled back toward the water.

text.te: మొసలి అతన్ని నీళ్లవైపు తిరిగి లాగింది.
text.hi: मगरमच्छ उसे वापस पानी की ओर खींचने लगा।
text.en: The crocodile pulled back toward the water.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: The two powerful creatures tugged in opposite directions.

text.te: ఆ రెండు బలమైన జంతువులు చెరో వైపు లాగుకున్నాయి.
text.hi: दोनों ताकतवर जीव विपरीत दिशाओं में खींच रहे थे।
text.en: The two powerful creatures tugged in opposite directions.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: At moments, Gajendra drew closer to the shore.

text.te: కొన్నిసార్లు గజేంద్రుడు ఒడ్డుకు కాస్త దగ్గరయ్యాడు.
text.hi: कभी गजेन्द्र किनारे के थोड़ा पास आ जाता।
text.en: At moments, Gajendra drew closer to the shore.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: At others, the crocodile drew him back toward deeper water.

text.te: మరికొన్నిసార్లు మొసలి అతన్ని మళ్లీ లోతు నీళ్లవైపు లాగింది.
text.hi: कभी मगरमच्छ उसे फिर गहरे पानी की ओर खींच ले जाता।
text.en: At others, the crocodile drew him back toward deeper water.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Gajendra braced himself and raised his trunk.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు కాళ్లు బిగించి, తొండాన్ని పైకెత్తాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र ने अपने पैर जमाए और सूँड ऊपर उठाई।
text.en: Gajendra braced himself and raised his trunk.

source_attribution.note: Original natural raised-trunk bracing gesture for visual continuity; the scripture does not specify this precise trunk movement.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Yet his leg remained in the crocodile's grip.

text.te: అయినా అతని కాలు మొసలి పట్టులోనే ఉంది.
text.hi: फिर भी उसका पैर मगरमच्छ की पकड़ में था।
text.en: Yet his leg remained in the crocodile's grip.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: The crocodile moved easily through the water.

text.te: నీటిలో మొసలి చురుగ్గా కదిలింది.
text.hi: पानी में मगरमच्छ आसानी से आगे बढ़ रहा था।
text.en: The crocodile moved easily through the water.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: The lake was its natural home.

text.te: ఆ నీళ్లే దానికి సహజమైన నివాసం.
text.hi: पानी उसका अपना स्वाभाविक घर था।
text.en: The lake was its natural home.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Gajendra was powerful, but he belonged on land.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు మాత్రం నేలపై బలంగా నడిచే ఏనుగు.
text.hi: लेकिन गजेन्द्र ज़मीन पर चलने वाला शक्तिशाली हाथी था।
text.en: Gajendra was powerful, but he belonged on land.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: It was harder for him to find firm footing in the water.

text.te: నీళ్లలో కాళ్లు గట్టిగా నిలబెట్టుకోవడం అతనికి కష్టంగా మారింది.
text.hi: पानी में पैर मज़बूती से जमाना उसके लिए कठिन था।
text.en: It was harder for him to find firm footing in the water.

source_attribution.note: An original physical-footing cinematic illustration of the crocodile's aquatic habitat; scripture does not describe this exact step or camera position.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: The crocodile did not loosen its hold.

text.te: మొసలి తన పట్టు మాత్రం విడవలేదు.
text.hi: मगरमच्छ ने अपनी पकड़ ढीली नहीं की।
text.en: The crocodile did not loosen its hold.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Gajendra pulled shoreward; the crocodile pulled lakeward.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఒడ్డువైపు లాగితే, మొసలి సరస్సులోకి లాగింది.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र किनारे की ओर खींचता, मगरमच्छ झील की ओर।
text.en: Gajendra pulled shoreward; the crocodile pulled lakeward.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: The struggle continued across the waterline.

text.te: ఇలా నీళ్ల దగ్గర వారి పోరాటం కొనసాగింది.
text.hi: इसी तरह पानी के किनारे उनका संघर्ष चलता रहा।
text.en: The struggle continued across the waterline.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Even mighty Gajendra found this watery battle difficult.

text.te: బలమైన గజేంద్రుడికీ ఆ నీళ్లలో పోరాటం సులువు కాదు.
text.hi: इतने बलवान गजेन्द्र के लिए भी पानी में जूझना आसान नहीं था।
text.en: Even mighty Gajendra found this watery battle difficult.

source_attribution.note: Original transition observation about Gajendra's difficulty in the water, inferred from SB 8.2.30 without claiming the later years-long power shift has occurred yet.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Their struggle did not end that day.

text.te: వారి పోరాటం ఆ రోజుతో ముగియలేదు.
text.hi: उनका संघर्ष उसी दिन समाप्त नहीं हुआ।
text.en: Their struggle did not end that day.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Days passed, yet the struggle went on.

text.te: రోజులు గడిచాయి. అయినా వారు పోరాడుతూనే ఉన్నారు.
text.hi: दिन बीतते गए, फिर भी वे जूझते रहे।
text.en: Days passed, yet the struggle went on.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Seasons changed, but the contest by the lake continued.

text.te: ఋతువులు మారినా సరస్సు దగ్గర ఆ పోరాటం ఆగలేదు.
text.hi: मौसम बदलते रहे, लेकिन झील के पास संघर्ष नहीं थमा।
text.en: Seasons changed, but the contest by the lake continued.

source_attribution.note: Original montage shorthand using changing seasons and light to visualize the scripture's explicit one-thousand-year duration; SB 8.2.29 does not prescribe seasonal shots.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: The years went by.

text.te: సంవత్సరాలు గడిచిపోయాయి.
text.hi: साल बीतते गए।
text.en: The years went by.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: In all, one thousand years passed.

text.te: అలా మొత్తం వెయ్యి సంవత్సరాలు గడిచాయి.
text.hi: ऐसे ही पूरे एक हज़ार वर्ष बीत गए।
text.en: In all, one thousand years passed.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Throughout those years, Gajendra and the crocodile pulled against each other.

text.te: అంత కాలం గజేంద్రుడు, మొసలి ఒకరినొకరు లాగుకుంటూనే ఉన్నారు.
text.hi: उस सारे समय गजेन्द्र और मगरमच्छ एक-दूसरे को खींचते रहे।
text.en: Throughout those years, Gajendra and the crocodile pulled against each other.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Their struggle moved between the water and the shore.

text.te: నీళ్లలోపలికి, ఒడ్డువైపుకి ఆ పోరాటం సాగింది.
text.hi: कभी पानी की ओर, कभी किनारे की ओर, उनका संघर्ष चलता रहा।
text.en: Their struggle moved between the water and the shore.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Even the devas watched the remarkable struggle in amazement.

text.te: దేవతలు కూడా ఈ ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పోరాటాన్ని చూశారు.
text.hi: देवताओं ने भी इस अनोखे संघर्ष को आश्चर्य से देखा।
text.en: Even the devas watched the remarkable struggle in amazement.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Convey the source-backed scene meaning: Still, Gajendra had not escaped the crocodile's grip.

text.te: అయినా గజేంద్రుడు మొసలి పట్టు నుంచి బయటపడలేదు.
text.hi: फिर भी गजेन्द्र मगरमच्छ की पकड़ से छूट नहीं सका।
text.en: Still, Gajendra had not escaped the crocodile's grip.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: Through the long struggle, Gajendra began to lose strength.

text.te: ఈ సుదీర్ఘ పోరాటంలో గజేంద్రుడి బలం తగ్గసాగింది.
text.hi: लंबे संघर्ष में गजेन्द्र की ताकत कम होने लगी।
text.en: Through the long struggle, Gajendra began to lose strength.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: His great body was no longer as strong as before.

text.te: అతని శరీరం మునుపటిలా బలంగా లేదు.
text.hi: उसका शरीर पहले जितना शक्तिशाली नहीं रहा।
text.en: His great body was no longer as strong as before.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: Even his energy and spirit began to fade.

text.te: అతని ఉత్సాహం కూడా మెల్లగా తగ్గింది.
text.hi: उसका उत्साह भी धीरे-धीरे कम हो गया।
text.en: Even his energy and spirit began to fade.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: The crocodile stayed in its own watery home.

text.te: మొసలి మాత్రం తనకు అలవాటైన నీళ్లలోనే ఉంది.
text.hi: लेकिन मगरमच्छ पानी में ही बना रहा, जो उसका अपना घर था।
text.en: The crocodile stayed in its own watery home.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: In the water, the crocodile grew stronger.

text.te: నీళ్లలో ఉండడంతో దాని బలం పెరుగుతూ వచ్చింది.
text.hi: पानी में रहने से उसकी ताकत बढ़ती गई।
text.en: In the water, the crocodile grew stronger.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: However hard Gajendra tried, he could not free his leg.

text.te: గజేంద్రుడు ఎంత ప్రయత్నించినా కాలును విడిపించుకోలేకపోయాడు.
text.hi: गजेन्द्र कितनी भी कोशिश करता, अपना पैर छुड़ा नहीं पाता।
text.en: However hard Gajendra tried, he could not free his leg.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: He knew his life was in danger.

text.te: తన ప్రాణం ప్రమాదంలో ఉందని అతనికి తెలిసింది.
text.hi: उसे समझ आ गया कि उसका जीवन संकट में था।
text.en: He knew his life was in danger.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: Though afraid, Gajendra began to think.

text.te: భయం వేసినా, గజేంద్రుడు ఆలోచించడం మొదలుపెట్టాడు.
text.hi: डर लगने पर भी गजेन्द्र सोचने लगा।
text.en: Though afraid, Gajendra began to think.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: He thought deeply about what to do in this danger.

text.te: ఈ కష్టంలో ఏమి చేయాలో అతను చాలా సేపు ఆలోచించాడు.
text.hi: इस कठिन समय में क्या करना चाहिए, वह बहुत देर तक सोचता रहा।
text.en: He thought deeply about what to do in this danger.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: After thinking deeply, Gajendra understood something important.

text.te: చాలా సేపు ఆలోచించిన తరువాత గజేంద్రుడికి ఒక విషయం అర్థమైంది.
text.hi: बहुत सोचने के बाद गजेन्द्र को एक बात समझ आई।
text.en: After thinking deeply, Gajendra understood something important.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: His own strength alone could not free him.

text.te: తన బలంతో మాత్రమే ఈ ప్రమాదం నుంచి బయటపడలేనని తెలిసింది.
text.hi: उसे समझ आया कि केवल अपनी ताकत से वह नहीं बच सकता।
text.en: His own strength alone could not free him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: He remembered that even his herd could not rescue him.

text.te: తనతో ఉన్న ఏనుగులూ అతన్ని రక్షించలేకపోయాయని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: उसे याद आया कि साथ के हाथी भी उसे बचा नहीं पाए।
text.en: He remembered that even his herd could not rescue him.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: Even those who loved him could not loosen the crocodile's grip.

text.te: తనను ప్రేమించే ఆడ ఏనుగులూ మొసలి పట్టు విడిపించలేకపోయాయి.
text.hi: उससे प्रेम करने वाली हथिनियाँ भी मगरमच्छ की पकड़ न छुड़ा सकीं।
text.en: Even those who loved him could not loosen the crocodile's grip.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: Then a clear decision arose in his heart.

text.te: అప్పుడు అతని మనసులో ఒక స్పష్టమైన నిర్ణయం వచ్చింది.
text.hi: तब उसके मन में एक साफ़ निर्णय आया।
text.en: Then a clear decision arose in his heart.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: He decided to seek shelter in the Supreme Lord.

text.te: అందరికీ ఆశ్రయమైన పరమాత్మను ఆశ్రయించాలని అనుకున్నాడు.
text.hi: उसने सबके आश्रय परम भगवान की शरण लेने का निश्चय किया।
text.en: He decided to seek shelter in the Supreme Lord.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: The Lord can protect those who sincerely seek His shelter.

text.te: భయపడినవారిని రక్షించగల శక్తి భగవంతుడికి ఉందని అతనికి తెలిసింది.
text.hi: वह जानता था कि भगवान शरण लेने वालों की रक्षा कर सकते हैं।
text.en: The Lord can protect those who sincerely seek His shelter.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: That refuge reaches beyond even the fear of death.

text.te: మరణ భయానికి మించిన ఆశ్రయం ఆ భగవంతుడే.
text.hi: मृत्यु के भय से भी परे वही भगवान सच्चा आश्रय हैं।
text.en: That refuge reaches beyond even the fear of death.

dialogue.speaker: NARRATOR
dialogue.intent: Narrate precisely: With that hope, Gajendra turned his heart toward prayer.

text.te: ఈ నమ్మకంతో గజేంద్రుడు తన మనసును ప్రార్థన వైపు మళ్లించాడు.
text.hi: इसी भरोसे गजेन्द्र ने अपना मन प्रार्थना की ओर लगाया।
text.en: With that hope, Gajendra turned his heart toward prayer.

source_attribution.note: Original brief devotional transition from Gajendra's scriptural decision to seek shelter (SB 8.2.31–33) toward the remembered prayer that begins in Episode 3; it does not claim a new audible prayer or divine appearance yet.
